fusions.name: Impossible Weight
fusions.desc: A leaping body-slam at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 14 damage, up to 1.6 times that at the full 7 tiles, and knocks it 3.5 tiles back.

fusions.name: Mauling Mouthful
fusions.desc: A raking swipe that deals 7 damage to everything in a cone 2.5 tiles ahead, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Engorge
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 20% for 15 seconds, and you heal 10 health.

fusions.name: Fat Stores
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
